summary:
Mission Architect is a browser-based space mission design game that challenges players to plan and execute a real solar system mission. Players choose a destination — the Moon, Mars, or Jupiter’s Europa — then build a spacecraft by selecting components within a budget, pick an optimal launch window, and navigate realistic mission events that test their engineering trade-offs.

Each decision affects the mission’s science score, budget, and success. At the end, a debrief compares the player’s mission to the real NASA mission that flew to that destination, complete with actual delta-V requirements and solar flux data.

Built with Unity WebGL so it runs entirely in the browser — no install required. Designed to make real orbital mechanics and mission planning intuitive and engaging for anyone curious about space exploration.

Technologies: Unity 2D, WebGL, C#, GitHub Pages
Play it: https://gs-new.github.io/Mission-Architect/
